context: An editor will edit seven articles, one at a time. Three of the articles—G, H, and J—cover finance; three other articles—Q, R, and S—cover nutrition; and the remaining article, Y, covers wildlife. The order in which the articles are edited is subject to the following conditions: Consecutive articles cannot cover the same topic as each other. S can be earlier than Q only if Q is third. S must be earlier than Y. J must be earlier than G, and G must be earlier than R.
question: Which one of the following is an acceptable order for editing the articles, from first through seventh?
options: A) H, S, J, Q, Y, G, R
B) J, Q, G, H, S, Y, R
C) Q, J, S, H, Y, G, R
D) Q, J, Y, S, G, R, H
E) S, G, Q, J, Y, R, H

articles = EnumSort([G, H, J, Q, R, S, Y])
topics = EnumSort([finance, nutrition, wildlife])
edit_order = Function([articles] -> [int])
topic_of = Function([articles] -> [topics])

# Constraints
ForAll([a:articles], And(1 <= edit_order(a), edit_order(a) <= 7)) ::: seven articles, one at a time
Distinct([a:articles], edit_order(a)) ::: each article edited exactly once
And(Count([a:articles], topic_of(a) == finance) == 3, Count([a:articles], topic_of(a) == nutrition) == 3, Count([a:articles], topic_of(a) == wildlife) == 1) ::: three finance (G,H,J), three nutrition (Q,R,S), one wildlife (Y)

Implies(edit_order(S) < edit_order(Q), edit_order(Q) == 3) ::: S can be earlier than Q only if Q is third
edit_order(S) < edit_order(Y) ::: S must be earlier than Y
And(edit_order(J) < edit_order(G), edit_order(G) < edit_order(R)) ::: J must be earlier than G, and G must be earlier than R
And(topic_of(G) == finance, topic_of(H) == finance, topic_of(J) == finance, topic_of(Q) == nutrition, topic_of(R) == nutrition, topic_of(S) == nutrition, topic_of(Y) == wildlife) ::: article topics are fixed

# Options
Question ::: Which one of the following is an acceptable order for editing the articles, from first through seventh?
is_sat(And(edit_order(H) == 1, edit_order(S) == 2, edit_order(J) == 3, edit_order(Q) == 4, edit_order(Y) == 5, edit_order(G) == 6, edit_order(R) == 7)) ::: (A)
